# Add Packages to README

Regenerates the autogenerated package table in the root [`README.md`](../../../README.md) between the `<!-- AUTOGENERATE_PACKAGE_START -->` and `<!-- AUTOGENERATE_PACKAGE_END -->` markers, with one row per public package in `libs/*/package.json`.

Used by [`release-please.yml`](../../workflows/release-please.yml) to keep the package table up to date on release branches.

## Usage

```yaml
- uses: ./.github/actions/add-packages-to-readme
```

The action mutates `README.md` in the workspace; committing the change is left to the calling workflow.

## Development

```sh
# run the unit tests
npx nx run add-packages-to-readme:test

# rebuild dist/main.js (must be committed)
npx nx run add-packages-to-readme:build
```
